reason: The independent vector-bundle Sobolev embedding theorem supplies a continuous representative and a bounded inclusion into L-infinity under a supercritical condition. The Lean root concludes only that a nonnegative real exists, with no section, inclusion, representative or norm inequality. Its full signature, including the actual implicit metric g, is discharged by C=0 without any Sobolev information. Therefore it does not state even the selected C0 component.
